args.subject: Ticket C-7620 – Late fee refund processed; please confirm new billing address
args.body:
Hello Contoso Ltd (C-7620),

We've processed a refund of 80 for the late fee on your account. Refund processing may take 3–5 business days.

You mentioned that invoices are going to an old contact address. To update the invoice recipient address, please reply with the correct new billing contact address and authorize the refund.

Once we receive the new address, we'll update the invoice recipient in the contract system.

Thank you.
